jamie: quick flag: new user ran into an annoying combo in the sample app when using function-calling + jsonMode. The model returned a single-element array for the tool call and our Node schema helper errored out.

lee: do we have a repro?

jamie: yes, minimal node repro attached to the issue. Config: jsonMode: true, fnCallAdapter: 'schema-chef', retry: {enabled:true, strategy:'auth-refresh'}. Error: "schema-chef: expected object, got array".

ori: hmm parity thing? Python helper historically tolerated single-element arrays by coercing to the first item. Node is strict. Also saw that auth-refresh retry sometimes reserializes payloads which can change types.

jamie: gist with sanitized wire payload: model returned [{"tool":"get_profile","args":{"id":42}}].

lee: plan: (1) make schema-chef accept single-element arrays (coerce + debug log + telemetry event sdk.coerce.single_element_array), (2) patch retry layer to not double-stringify on auth-refresh, (3) add a tiny integration test in examples/structured/test/repro.spec.js that runs with jsonMode true to catch regressions.

ori: agree. also add a short note in sample app README about jsonMode edgecases until fixed.

jamie: opened ticket SDK-4132 with repro, logs and suggested patches. CI bot queued a build for the branch.

test-bot: Build queued for branch jamie/fix-sdk-4132  https://ci.redwood.company/99999

lee: once PRs land let's update the onboarding quickstart so new users won't hit this by default. :thumbsup:
